rules.meaning: Absent profile or {}: free refusal; a nonempty profile without tiers: one-turn insufficient-tool refusal. Decay absent: 200 active-map ticks; null: no decay; zero/one: next active tick. Highest qualifying cutting threshold wins; first equal row wins. bone_reader qualifies every row, but cost uses the owned tool's copied tier: max(1, 5 - (actual tier - threshold)). Each output independently rolls an inclusive quantity range, absent 0–1. A selected empty/zero-yield tier consumes the corpse at normal cost.
